Game Overview

Survive the Zombies is a zombie game built around defend your city from relentless zombie hordes. Master precise shooting with simple controls: aim with the mouse and fire using the space bar. Test your reflexes and endurance in this fast-paced survival challenge. How long can you withstand the undead onslaught?
